spanish: Y las tablas chapó de oro, y sus anillos hizo de oro, casas a los travesaños, y chapó los travesaños de oro.

findings.issue: Bare זָהָב is a material noun with no preposition. Spanish inserts unmarked de before each oro; the material reading stays the same.

notes: Plural boards, rings, houses, and bars, 3ms piel chapó and qal hizo, suffix sus, and both bar phrases stay open and repeated.
